import csv, io
# deterministic LCG (no random module dependency parity worries)
_s=[12345]
def rnd(n):
    _s[0]=(_s[0]*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff
    return _s[0]%n
alpha=['a','b',',','"',"'","\\",'\n','\r','|',' ','1','2.5','','x y','\t']
n=0
for trial in range(1500):
    q=rnd(4); esc=[None,'\\','^'][rnd(3)]; dq=rnd(2)==0
    delim=[',','|',';'][rnd(3)]; qc=['"',"'"][rnd(2)]; lt=['\r\n','\n','#'][rnd(3)]
    sis=rnd(2)==0; st=rnd(2)==0
    row=[''.join(alpha[rnd(len(alpha))] for _ in range(rnd(4))) for _ in range(1+rnd(4))]
    o=io.StringIO(); n+=1
    try:
        csv.writer(o,quoting=q,escapechar=esc,doublequote=dq,delimiter=delim,
                   quotechar=qc,lineterminator=lt).writerow(row)
        wv=repr(o.getvalue())
    except Exception as e:
        wv="EXC "+type(e).__name__+": "+str(e)
    try:
        back=repr(list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(o.getvalue()),quoting=q,escapechar=esc,
                doublequote=dq,delimiter=delim,quotechar=qc,skipinitialspace=sis,strict=st)))
    except Exception as e:
        back="EXC "+type(e).__name__+": "+str(e)
    print(trial,wv,"->",back)
print("N",n)
